name: Doubutsu no Mori e+: PR - Shinabiru
summary: Shinabiru is a jock duck villager in Doubutsu no Mori e+. He can only move into the player's town if his e-Reader card is scanned. His card is a promotional card that was bundled exclusively with the September 5, 2003 issue of Weekly Famitsu (Vol. 768) and the October 2003 issue of Famitsu Cube + Advance.
